tool_args.rationale: The pilot has a sigmoidal onset and substantial sink-gradient variation, matching the recalled four-parameter cooperative Hill inhibition mechanism. Fit all four parameters numerically and test it on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows already span s_grad from 0.25 to 2.25, well above the specified ambiguity threshold.
These alternatives do not account for the strong sink-gradient dependence in the observations.
The specified stationary Hill mechanism can be fit and freshly confirmed without trajectory measurements.
